title: 99-1 전략 실전 — 교통수단 문제 답변 | 오픽노잼 020
summary: 99-1 전략: 하나의 주제(99%)에만 집중하면서 1%만 대조(contrast) — 완전히 다른 주제로 넘어가면 채점관이 연결고리를 잃는다
교통수단 문제 답변: 차에서 이상한 소리 → 보험사/정비사 호출 → 수리 완료 — 문제·감정·이유 3요소 유지하면서 해결 과정만 서술
'I ended up blaming the train' — 자책하기 싫을 때 쓰는 유머 표현, 채점관 집중도 상승
결론(conclusion)에서 해결책을 반드시 언급 — 해결 못 했으면 못 했다고 설명하는 것도 OK
과거경험 질문은 전부 과거시제 — 'it is my fault' → 'it was my fault'

keyExpressions.en: I heard some weird noise from the car.
keyExpressions.note: 교통 문제 메인 포인트 첫 문장

keyExpressions.en: I was overly worried about that.
I had no choice but to call the mechanic.
keyExpressions.note: I had no choice but to + 동사원형

keyExpressions.en: I ended up blaming the train.
keyExpressions.note: end up + ~ing: 결국 ~하게 됐다 — 유머 포인트

keyExpressions.en: I wanted to point fingers at something else.
Something good did come out of it, but overall...
keyExpressions.note: 99-1: 작은 긍정 → 다시 부정 메인으로 복귀

cards.back: I heard some weird noise from the car.
cards.example: When I got into my car, I heard some weird noise and I was overly worried about that.

cards.back: I had no choice but to call the mechanic.
cards.example: I had no choice but to call the mechanic, and he fixed it up right away.

cards.back: I ended up blaming the train.
cards.example: It was my fault for missing the train, but I ended up blaming the train because I didn't want to blame myself.

cards.back: I wanted to point fingers at something else.
cards.example: I was so frustrated at myself, so I just wanted to point fingers at something else.
It wasn't the train's fault — it was definitely my fault for being late.

cards.back: Something good did come out of it, but overall I ended up being very late.
